node.statement: Threshold bridge and exact scope. Node 1.1, not nodes 1.2-1.4, proves 0<=t_1=K_1*epsilon<=e_1, and it proves this only under the explicit additional premise there that c_0^cb is a fixed finite nonnegative universal constant. Under precisely that premise, combine node 1.1 with the completed record of the preceding child: the projection, complementarity, component-map, and target-ambient defects listed in nodes 1.2-1.4 are each at most t_1, while t_1<=e_1, so every pre-application antecedent of lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement is present. Without that additional premise this child makes no smallness or universality claim; hence it repairs the dependency bookkeeping at node 1.6.1 but leaves intact the separate obstruction at node 1.1 to the unconditional root.
